com.invoiceparserpro/capability.category: Cached accounting data and posting rules
com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Choose an active posting account from the saved chart for one invoice. May update learned vendor coding; manual vendor rules stay unchanged. Creates no bill or payment. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: List the active cached posting accounts for the connected provider. Preview coding the invoice we selected to the account I choose, explain any learned-rule effect, and wait for confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_set_invoice_posting_account, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare choosing an active account from this workspace's cached chart. Supplier and account names come from saved records. Reuses review coding: manual vendor rules stay unchanged; otherwise its learned vendor rule/counter is updated. No provider refresh, bill push or payment. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: set_invoice_posting_account
title: Select an invoice posting account
